title: Ice bridge lined with small fir trees, used before the bridge was built
description: This photo was taken at the river shore at the end of Maple Street, where an ice bridge once allowed travel to the west side. Small fir trees lined the passage, guiding travellers. The photograph predates the construction of the Hartland Bridge in 1901.
credit: Doris Kennedy Collection — Hartland Community Historical Society
